question: What capacity per gram of sulfur did the cathode deliver at cycle 1500 at 1C, and what share is that of the reversible capacity it showed at 1C in the rate test?
rendered: According to the text, the cathode delivered a capacity of 306 mAh/g after 1500 cycles at 1C. The reversible capacity it showed at 1C in the rate test was 370 mAh/g. Therefore, the capacity per gram of sulfur at cycle 1500 is 83% of the reversible capacity it showed at 1C in the rate test.
